SBA COMMUNICATIONS CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES  
NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS  
   
The following table summarizes the Company’s activities with respect to its stock option plans for the years ended December 31, 2012, 
2011 and 2010 as follows (dollars and number of shares in thousands, except for per share data):

SBAC_2012_p120__caption_0.ocr:
The weighted-average per share fair value of options granted during the years ended December 31, 2012, 2011 and 2010 was $20.31, 
$18.53 and $15.88, respectively.

SBAC_2012_p120__paragraph_1.ocr:
The total intrinsic value for options exercised during the years ended December 31, 2012, 2011 and 2010 was $49.0 million, $12.7 
million and $17.8 million, respectively. Cash received from option exercises under all plans for the years ended December 31, 2012, 2011 and 
2010 was approximately $32.0 million, $15.2 million and $15.1 million, respectively. No tax benefit was realized for the tax deductions from 
option exercises under all plans for the years ended December 31, 2012, 2011 and 2010, respectively.

SBAC_2012_p120__paragraph_2.ocr:
The aggregate intrinsic value for stock options in the preceding tables represents the total intrinsic value based on the Company’s closing 
stock price of $70.98 as of December 31, 2012. The amount represents the total intrinsic value that would have been received by the holders of 
the stock-based awards had these awards been exercised and sold as of that date.
